description: Default capability set for the OnScreen desktop window. Least privilege: the webview only gets core IPC (app commands + events) and the notification plugin it calls from JS. The store, global-shortcut, dialog, tray and window plugins are driven Rust-side only (Rust plugin APIs need no capability), so they are deliberately NOT granted to the webview: a script injected into the webview could otherwise write server_url straight into settings.json (bypassing set_server_url's validation), register system-wide key hooks, or read the settings store.
